newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Feb 20.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Thursday:
BEIJING - Deng Xiaoping, who oversaw China's economic transformation and ordered the bloody crackdown on democracy demonstrators in 1989, died Wednesday night at the age of 92.

BEIJING - China now lies more firmly than ever in the hands of its president and Communist Party chief Jiang Zemin, the leader of a government that in the last three years has rallied Chinese nationalism, lectured its own people on moral integrity, fired missiles near the shores of Taiwan and rebuffed American entreaties on human rights.

WASHINGTON - An executive of an Asian-American business association said he was approached by Democratic fund-raiser John Huang last summer and asked to funnel more than $250,000 through its members as contributions to the Democratic National Committee in return for a $45,000 payment to the group.

WASHINGTON - A popular fertility technique that allows men with defective sperm to sire babies has led to what scientists believe are the first clear cases of "inherited infertility" in which newborns carry the genetic glitch that seems to have caused their fathers' infertility.

KANSAS CITY, Mo. - In her own way these days, First Lady Hillary Rodham Clinton is carrying out an experiment -- testing political themes and techniques to find the right combination for the second Clinton term.
ANDERSON, S.C. - After a brief truce, the war over the Confederate flag is flaring anew in the only state where a full-fledged version still flies over the capital.
